beats.narration_text: Olá — this is Liam, in for Komal, for Madison's weekly update. Team Madison has three tracks this week. SurveyMind: the paper's method failed again, so they are designing their own fake-data generator — eighty-twenty holdout, sent for review. Plus the thirty-nine prompt laptop set, collected and mapped. And Loon Conservatory: the app is built, testing is underway.

beats.narration_text: First receipt: SurveyMind. They tried the paper's method one more time. It kept breaking. The paper was on GitHub. The actual data was not. Four papers: DeepPersona tests fakes against the same real personality set. Psychology of Machines used ChatGPT for fake profiles, checked statistically. One method: quiz, then a short bio. Big Five Personality Essays: a ChatGPT fake set, checked for balance. Literature. Not a generator yet.

beats.narration_text: The plan: split the real data. Eighty percent to build the fake-data generator. Twenty percent held out — completely separate — to test it after. That checks new data, not the answer key. The plan is sent for review. A plan is not a run.

beats.narration_text: Separately, the laptop study finalized a thirty-nine prompt set: baseline, student, developer, creative, and enterprise. Responses collected in Claude — Opus five point five, medium effort, web search on. Repeated in fresh chats. Mapped to prompt IDs. A status tracker and a coding sheet. Initial comparison of brand recommendations and first-listed choices. Preliminary findings drafted into the paper. Comparison tables across two pilot rounds. That is collection. Not a ranking.
